decisions.reason: After several years without visible website support, this adjacent conferencing offer is easier to sacrifice in a crowded market, and the remaining sunk-cost pull is weaker than for the firm's core infrastructure services.

This service is tightly tied to the firm's owned metro, data-centre and cloud-connectivity assets, and earlier adoption gives management enough justification to continue despite lower recent visibility.

Optical spectrum connectivity remains close to the announced high-bandwidth strategic direction, so prior investment and public commitment still encourage persistence even if marketing visibility has faded.

A number-ordering portal supports the move toward software-defined, real-time provisioning, and management is likely to retain it as part of that digitisation path rather than admit the development effort was misplaced.
Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony offer with weak fit to the firm's stated future, so once weak visibility is added, escalation of commitment is no longer enough to prevent withdrawal.
